description: tools.status in a world where two rows have drifted: `bash` reports `differs` with the FIELD NAMES that disagree (description, schema_hash — a report that said only "wrong" would leave the operator guessing), and `grep` reports `missing_row` because its row is gone while the code still implements it. Nothing was repaired: the row stayed tampered with and the tool stayed absent, because TC11's ruling is that drift is SAID and the applier is not a read — silently fixing a disagreement is the one outcome worse than admitting it. `seed` is the engine's own ledger read through the ONE engine `seed.status` reads (same set, same versions, no second stamp), and it says `partial` here for the same two rows — the ledger remembers applying `grep` while the world no longer has it, so the engine's own per-record summary and the drift report agree rather than each holding a private answer (a status panel that said `applied, current` beside a drifted row would be two truths in one screen), and `counts` is one pass over the same world the listing serves, so the two panels cannot disagree about how many tools there are. `drift` is the DISAGREEMENT list — a row that agrees contributes nothing here and still sets `rowCurrent:true` on its entry.
